description: Public interface of the chemistry tools used by the EMBench seed tasks. Only names, parameters and defaults are described here; in Harbor tasks the tools are served by a fixture server that replays recorded results.

tools.name: nameToSmiles
tools.description: Convert a chemical name (common name, abbreviation or IUPAC name) into a SMILES string.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Chemical name, e.g. TNT or CL-20.

tools.name: validateSmiles
tools.description: Check whether a SMILES string is valid; returns validity, formula, atom and bond counts.

tools.name: drawMolecule
tools.description: Draw a 2D structure image of a molecule.

tools.name: smilesTo3D
tools.description: Generate 3D atomic coordinates for a molecule.

tools.name: batchPredictProperties
tools.description: Predict properties for a batch of molecules. Property codes: Density, DetoD, DetoP, DetoQ, DetoT, DetoV, HOF_S, Td, BDE.

parameters.name: properties
parameters.description: Property codes to predict; all if omitted.

tools.name: calculateOxygenBalance
tools.description: Compute the oxygen balance (OB_CO, OB_CO2) of molecules.

tools.name: calculateKJ
tools.description: Compute detonation parameters with the Kamlet-Jacobs equations. Pass smiles to predict density and heat of formation automatically, or pass density, hof_s and formula directly.

parameters.name: hof_s
parameters.description: Solid-state heat of formation in kJ/mol (direct mode).

tools.name: generateAndPredict
tools.description: Generate new candidate molecules and optionally predict their properties.

parameters.name: use_em
parameters.description: Use the domain-specific generator (true) or the general one (false).

parameters.name: properties
parameters.description: Property codes to predict for the generated molecules.

parameters.name: skip_prediction
parameters.description: Only generate SMILES, without property prediction.

tools.name: predictRetrosynthesis
tools.description: Retrosynthesis analysis: search synthesis routes for a molecule.

parameters.name: smiles
parameters.description: SMILES string of the target molecule.

parameters.name: max_routes
parameters.description: Maximum number of routes to return.

tools.name: magusStatus
tools.description: Report whether the crystal-structure generation module is available.

tools.name: magusGenerate
tools.description: Generate crystal structures for a chemical formula.
